title: Not very usable when using a desktop arrangement that's different from the panel's orientation
line: A Pager in a vertical panel now shows desktops that are in one row as a usable column, and vice versa in horizontal panels.
explanation: The pager always drew KWin's desktop grid as it is, scaled to fit the panel's thickness. With 4 desktops in one row in a 44 px vertical panel, that made a 36x5 px strip of four slivers, too small to see or hit (and a one-column layout did the same in a horizontal panel). The pager now transposes the grid (swapping rows and columns and filling it top to bottom) when the grid's long side runs against the panel's orientation, so each desktop keeps its relative position and gets a usable size. The activity pager's explicit Horizontal/Vertical layout setting is left alone.

commits.message:
applets/pager: transpose the desktop grid when it doesn't fit the panel

Desktops in one row made a pager in a vertical panel a strip of tiny
slivers, and one column did the same in a horizontal panel. The pager
now shows the grid transposed when it runs against the panel's layout.

BUG: 474114

media.caption: Master: 4 desktops in one row, Pager in a 44 px left panel is a tiny strip of slivers (3x zoom).
Fix: the same Pager shows the 4 desktops as a column of usable cells (3x zoom).
Fix: 6 desktops in 2 rows show as 3 rows x 2 columns in the vertical panel; the Konsole window on desktop 3 appears in desktop 3's cell.
Fix: 6 desktops in one column show as a single row in the horizontal bottom panel.

review.text: Transposing the Pager grid with Grid.TopToBottom when the virtual desktop grid runs against the panel orientation is a clean, readable solution that preserves desktop order and works properly with window outlines, drag-and-drop, and the Activity Pager's explicit layout override. However, the transposed condition checks `root.vertical ? desktopColumns > desktopRows : desktopRows > desktopColumns`, which treats non-panel form factors (such as PlasmaCore.Types.Planar when the Pager is placed on the desktop) as horizontal panels. As a result, a Pager widget on the desktop with a vertical desktop arrangement (e.g. 4 rows by 1 column) would be forcibly transposed into a horizontal row.
changes: Restrict transposition to panel form factors by explicitly checking Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal instead of using the else branch of root.vertical (e.g. `(root.vertical && desktopColumns > desktopRows) || (Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Horizontal && desktopRows > desktopColumns)`), so Planar/desktop pagers keep their true grid orientation.
